title: Recover a set-valued topos point from sheafified representables
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention], and let $p:\mathbf{Set}\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. For $U\in\mathcal C$ let $h_U(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(T,U)$, let $h_U^\#$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and put $u(U)=p^{-1}(h_U^\#)$. Then $u$ preserves finite limits, and for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ the maps $u(U_i)\to u(U)$ are jointly surjective. Let $\mathcal N_u$ have objects $(U,a)$ with $a\in u(U)$ and arrows $f:(U,a)\to(V,b)$ given by arrows $f:U\to V$ satisfying $u(f)(a)=b$. This category is small and cofiltered. For every sheaf of sets $F$ the canonical map
$$\varinjlim_{(U,a)\in\mathcal N_u^{\mathrm{op}}} F(U)\longrightarrow p^{-1}F,$$
sending a section $t:h_U^\#\to F$ at $(U,a)$ to $p^{-1}(t)(a)$, is a bijection natural in $F$. Colimits and cofilteredness use [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
